description.value: Bread x Butter is a gourmet sandwich and breakfast cafe situated at the corner of Hornby and Georgia in downtown Vancouver, built around freshly baked artisan bread and locally sourced ingredients. The menu leans into Asian fusion touches — wagyu beef with kewpie mayo, unagi egg toast, Hawaiian Luau SPAM brioche — alongside classic breakfast and sandwich fare. The cafe also features a beautiful outdoor courtyard accommodating up to 200 people and a fully licensed bar, doubling as a private event venue.

address.value: 925 West Georgia Street, Unit 140, Vancouver, BC

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces) at 43m; stands (30 spaces) at 60m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 44 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms the phone number (604)-631-3981 and downtown Vancouver location at the corner of Hornby and Georgia, consistent with OSM tags. The menu pages explicitly label vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options, and the navigation includes an 'Online Order' link indicating takeout is available. No bike-specific amenities (racks, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: Website uses the name 'Bread & Butter' interchangeably with 'Bread x Butter' in several passages; OSM name 'Bread x Butter' matches the domain and primary branding.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active cafe in downtown Vancouver with a live website, online ordering, and confirmed contact details — straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking food and drink.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Catering menu uses 'VG - Vegetarian | GF - Gluten Free' labels throughout; explicit vegan items listed (vegan avocado toast, vegan cookies, vegan apple muffin, fully vegan boxed breakfast options); gluten-free loaf and GF bread substitution available

wow_evidence: outdoor courtyard accommodating up to 200 people
